actions.action: Check for fuzzy grey mould on dead flowers and leaf bases
Deadhead spent flowers by pinching their stalks
Cut off finished flower stalks at the base
Move plant to a cool, bright-shade spot (shady balcony corner)
Check top 1-2 cm of soil and water the soil when dry, then empty saucer
After flowering, plant it in a shady part of the garden

reason: The answer correctly says the plant is healthy and old flowers are fading normally, leads with deadheading and moving it outdoors as the thread advised, and its extra cautions about misting and heat are mild and harmless.
